greetBot.description: [Step 1: User sends Hi/Hello message to the bot]

authenticate.description: [Step 2: Initialization & Authentication] Checks if phone number exists in MySQL 'users' table. Transitions to welcome state if registered, otherwise to unauthorized terminal state.

unauthorized.description: [Step 1: Initialization & Authentication] Terminal state. Sends authorization rejection message and ends session.

text: Welcome to Anand Dairy Please select language

welcome.description: [Step 2: Initialization & Authentication] Sends welcome greeting (e.g. Welcome to Anand Dairy Farm!) and auto-advances to Step 2 (Language Selection).

showLanguageSelection.description: [Step 3: Language Selection] Sends quick reply buttons (English / Marathi). Clicking a button returns payload 'lang_en' or 'lang_mr'.

setLanguage.description: [Step 2: Language Selection] Sets session language to selected language and advances to Step 3 (Main Menu).

mainMenu.description: [Step 3: Main Menu] Sends main menu options as buttons. Clicking 'Add Milk Production' or 'Add Milk Consumption' routes the user to their respective date selection states.

entryTypeSelection.description: [Step 3: Entry Type Selection] Waits for user selection of Add Milk Production or Add Milk Consumption.

setEntryType.description: [Step 3: Set Entry Type] Sets selected entry type in session and routes user to corresponding date selection state.

showDateSelection.description: [Step 3: Show Date Selection (Production)] Sends quick reply buttons (Yesterday, Today, Enter Past Date) for milk production entry.

dateSelection.description: [Step 3: Date Selection (Production)] Prompts the user to select today, yesterday, or a past date for milk production entry.

setDate.description: [Step 3: Set Selected Date (Production)] Determines which date selection action to execute based on yesterday, today, or past date choice.

setTodayDate.description: [Step 3: Set Date (Production)] Sets the production date to today in IST and auto-advances to the entry prompt.

setYesterdayDate.description: [Step 3: Set Date (Production)] Sets the production date to yesterday in IST and auto-advances to the entry prompt.

enterPastDate.description: [Step 3: Enter Past Date (Production)] Waits for manual date input in DD/MM/YYYY format, validates it, and sets the date.

setPastDate.description: [Step 3: Set Entered Past Date (Production)] Sets the verified manual past date in the session and proceeds to milk entry.

message:
You can now add milk production data. Please use the format below:

Cow Name, M = X, E = Y

Example:
Gauri, M = 8, E = 6
Laxmi, Morning Milk = 0, Evening Milk = 5
showMilkEntry.description: [Step 4: Milk Data Entry Prompt] Sends the format instruction and example for cow entries.

milkEntryInput.description: [Step 4: Milk Data Entry Input] Waits for user text input, parses the entries, resolves cow IDs, and saves to session.

reviewSummary.description: [Step 5: Review Summary (Production)] Generates a text summary of the entered production records.

editEntryInput.description: [Step 5: Edit Entry (Production)] Waits for user correction input, updates the matched records, and returns to summary.

submitData.description: [Step 6: Submit Data (Production)] Action to insert/update the records in the backend database and clear the session.

message: Milk production data successfully recorded! Thank you!
submissionSuccess.description: [Step 6: Submission Success (Production)] Terminal state. Sends a success confirmation message.

message: Submission failed. Please try again or contact your dairy administrator.
submissionFailure.description: [Step 6: Submission Failure (Production)] Notifies user of DB error and returns to confirm/edit screen.

dateSelectionConsumption.description: [Step 3: Date Selection (Consumption)] Prompts the user to select today, yesterday, or a past date for milk utilization entry.

setTodayDateConsumption.description: [Step 3: Set Date (Consumption)] Sets the consumption date to today in IST and auto-advances to the entry prompt.

setYesterdayDateConsumption.description: [Step 3: Set Date (Consumption)] Sets the consumption date to yesterday in IST and auto-advances to the entry prompt.

enterPastDateConsumption.description: [Step 3: Enter Past Date (Consumption)] Waits for manual date input in DD/MM/YYYY format, validates it, and sets the date.

message:
You can now add milk consumption/utilization data. Please use the format below:

Purpose = Quantity

Example:
Local Sale = 15
Calf Feeding = 5
consumptionEntryPrompt.description: [Step 4: Milk Consumption Entry Prompt] Sends the format instruction and example for milk utilization entries.

consumptionEntryInput.description: [Step 4: Milk Consumption Entry Input] Waits for user text input, parses the utilization purpose and quantity, and saves to session.

reviewSummaryConsumption.description: [Step 5: Review Summary (Consumption)] Generates a text summary of the entered consumption records.

confirmOrEditConsumption.description: [Step 5: Confirm or Edit (Consumption)] Asks the user to submit or modify their consumption entries.

editConsumptionEntry.description: [Step 5: Edit Entry (Consumption)] Waits for user correction input, updates the matched records, and returns to summary.

submitConsumptionData.description: [Step 6: Submit Data (Consumption)] Action to insert/update the records in the backend milk_utilization table and clear the session.

message: Milk consumption data successfully recorded! Thank you!
submissionSuccessConsumption.description: [Step 6: Submission Success (Consumption)] Terminal state. Sends a success confirmation message.

message: Submission failed. Please try again or contact your dairy administrator.
submissionFailureConsumption.description: [Step 6: Submission Failure (Consumption)] Notifies user of DB error and returns to confirm/edit screen.
